messages:
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] Initiating phased rollout v2.6.0 -> US=12%, EU=0%, APAC=0% (canary). Change window 2024-10-05 22:30-02:30 UTC. Auto-holdpoints at 12%.
Dana: Kicking off US canary. Monitoring payment and search routes closely.
Omar: US warmpool pre-warmed. p50 token latency 98ms, p95 198ms. warm nodes 44/50. No 5xx.
Leila: EU reserved pool 32 GPUs, current allocation 77%. Danger zone if we push EU >10% during peak; could reach 86% within ~20m.
SRE Oncall: Thermal headroom 15%. Eviction plan set at warmpool <72%. Will post alerts at 78% and 84%.
Dana: If EU hits >85% we agreed to pin EU back to v2.5.x and throttle. Confirm rollback criteria?
Omar: Rollback triggers: (1) p95 >2x baseline for >=10m, (2) route error rate >0.9% sustained 5m, (3) GPU OOMs >=2 in 4m, (4) warm node loss >=9% in 5m.
Deploy Bot: US slice 12% healthy. checks=ok(54/54), errs=0, avgGPU=28%.
Infra-Priv Bot: APAC artifact egress blocked until INF-520 resolved. Ticket created.
Leila: APAC has no reserved warmpool for this release. If we need to start APAC early we'll need +7 transient GPUs and infra-priv allowlist.
SRE Oncall: +1 to transient burst after INF-520 cleared. I'll keep thermal and eviction hooks open.
Dana: Runbook for quick ops (pin then throttle then rollback):
```
redwoodctl pin --region eu --version v2.5.7
redwoodctl throttle --region eu --percent 5
redwoodctl rollback --release v2.6.0 --reason "eu capacity/latency"
```
Omar: Enabling KV-cache sticky on US canary to reduce cold token p95. Keep an eye for any variance in outputs.
Deploy Bot: Queued EU ramp -> target 5% after US holdpoint.
SRE Oncall: EU @5% (2m): p50=122ms, p95=250ms, errs=0. Warmpool usage +1%. No OOMs.
Leila: Noting that security audit logging is enabled for EU slice. Snapshot created.
Dana: Hold EU at 5% for 12m. If stable, ramp to 20% next wave. If any rollback trigger hits, call pin and annotate reason in thread.
Deploy Bot: Holdpoint reached. US/EU at 12/5. APAC pending INF-520. Next ramp requires manual ack.
SRE Oncall: Standing by; will escalate if eviction or thermal breaches.
Dana: I'll update #release-updates after the 12m readout. Ping here for any manual actions.
Leila: :thumbsup:
Omar: Thanks team, standing by for the ramp ack.
